{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-sj6v","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-fcs3: protect_response missing allow_no_piv_response check — 10 test failures","description":"## Root cause

`Context::protect_response` (lib.rs:949-1040) never reads the `self.allow_no_piv_response` field. The field is set (in `register_fresh`, `restore_existing`, `new_ephemeral`, `restore`) but never checked before allowing an `include_piv=false` response.

## Test failures

All 10 failures are `unwrap_err()` panicking on `Ok` or replay errors bubbling where they shouldn't:

1. `fresh_context_activates_only_after_atomic_registration` — unregistered context should reject no-PIV response, got `Ok`
2. `restored_context_rejects_response_without_piv` — restored context should reject no-PIV response, got `Ok`
3. `supplied_material_restores_authoritative_state_and_disables_no_piv` — same
4. `response_without_piv_requires_requester_identity` — expected rejection, got `Ok`
5. `response_without_piv_is_one_shot_per_request` — expected replay rejection, got `Ok`
6. `delayed_explicit_piv_ordinary_response_ignores_peer_replay_window` — got `Replay`
7. `dropped_pending_response_preserves_committed_window_across_large_jump` — got `Replay`
8. `oversized_explicit_piv_response_does_not_poison_valid_retry` — got `Replay`
9. `public_unprotect_rejects_malformed_inner_options` — got `Ok` instead of error
10. `test_roundtrip_with_0xff_in_class_e_options` — got `SeqExhausted`

## Fix needed

Add an `allow_no_piv_response` guard in `protect_response` at the start of the `include_piv=false` branch, returning `InvalidParam` when `!self.allow_no_piv_response`.","status":"open","priority":0,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"agent@lichen-project.dev","created_at":"2026-07-24T18:28:41.936882496Z","created_by":"AI Agent","updated_at":"2026-07-24T18:28:41.936882496Z"}
